__doc: Fees collected, rewards distributed and the holder count, published by
scripts/index-rewards.mjs on a schedule so that no visitor has to compute
them. Reading a few hundred thousand blocks of Base in the browser takes
dozens of RPC calls and about a minute of an uninterrupted tab: a desktop
waits it out, a phone gets backgrounded and shows em dashes. These figures
are served immediately instead, and app.js's own chain scan refines them
EVERY FIELD IS null AND THAT IS THE LAUNCH STATE, NOT A FAULT. The indexer
has not run, and it will refuse to run until worker/src/config.js is filled
in from .github/workflows/discover.yml — including HOLDER_SHARE, which must
be read off this token's own Stockify panel. Nulls render as em dashes,
which is the honest answer while a total is unknown.
data/rewards-state.json is deliberately ABSENT until then. loadState()
falls back to START_BLOCK only when that file is missing, so an empty or
templated cursor sitting in a present file would be read as gospel and
scan Base from genesis. It gets committed, seeded with cursor =
START_BLOCK, in the same change that fills in the config.
